title: THE LONG ONE IS HERE! 🔴 Aerosoft x ToLiss A340-600 PRO | Full Review & First Flight
description:
The "Long One" has finally arrived in Microsoft Flight Simulator! ✈️ Today at 20:00 CET, we are going hands-on with the brand-new Aerosoft x ToLiss A340-600 PRO.

This isn't just any aircraft release—it combines the stunning visual modeling of Aerosoft with the legendary, study-level systems of ToLiss. In this livestream, we are doing a complete "Unpacking" of this massive four-engine jet.

In this stream:
✅ Liveries: Exploring the launch day textures (Lufthansa, Virgin, Iberia & more).
✅ Walkaround: A deep dive into the exterior modeling and that iconic center landing gear.
✅ Cabin Tour: Checking out the interior fidelity and passenger experience.
✅ Systems: First look at the ToLiss FBW, MCDU, and custom EFB integration.
✅ Takeoff: Setting up for a heavy departure and testing the flight model.

Aircraft History:
We’ll also discuss the history of the A340-600—the aircraft that was once the longest commercial jet in the world and the backbone of "Four Engines 4 Long Haul."

Topics we will discuss:
- liveries
- exterior walkaround
- full interior/cabin tour
- cockpit setup
- engine start & taxi
- first takeoff and flight model test
- final verdict & Q&A
